ns2:course.label: Advanced Graphic Design II
ns2:course.description: This capstone studio continues design investigations in the interest of understanding and confidently articulating individual interests and abilities. This studio also focuses on the refinement of a comprehensive portfolio; self, peer, faculty, and outside review of student work; and an enhanced study of the field in preparation for professional practice. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term. Prerequisite: ARTD 410 and senior standing in graphic design; for graduate credit - consent of graphic design program chair.
